The questions of a study's AI drafts, and the person's answers to them

Source: R/ai_agent.R
tfl_ai_questions.Rd

ai/questions.md holds what the AI could not settle – an assumption's question, gathered by tfl_ai_run(): one question asked by several reports once, the reports listed. tfl_ai_questions() reads it; a screen shows the questions and takes the answers, and tfl_ai_answer_questions() writes them back – each into its question's - Answer:, everything else as it is. The agent (or the person) then moves an answered question to ai/decisions.md, sets its status to decided, and redoes the reports it touches.

Usage

tfl_ai_questions(study_dir)

tfl_ai_answer_questions(study_dir, answers)

Arguments

study_dir

The study folder.

answers

The answers: a data frame with id ("Q1") and answer, or a character vector named by the ids. NA or "" empties an answer.

Value

tfl_ai_questions(): a data frame, one row a question: id, output_id (the reports it touches, comma-separated), where, question, provisional (what the AI took for now), answer (NA when none), status (open, decided); no row when there is no question. tfl_ai_answer_questions(): the file's path, invisibly.

Details

The file: each question a block from its heading ## Q<n>. <question> to the next heading, holding - Reports:, - Where:, - The agent took, for now:, - Status: open (or decided) and - Answer: (one line or more, to the block's end).

See also

tfl_ai_run(), tfl_ai_prepare() (mode = "agent").
